title: Hi, I'm Siyuan Qian
tagline: I'm a Ph.D. candidate in the HMI Lab at Peking University, advised by Prof. Shanghang Zhang. Rooted in embodied AI, my research explores generalizable multimodal agents that perceive, reason, and act in complex physical and virtual environments. I am particularly interested in vision-language-action (VLA) models, world models, and hierarchical agent architectures for long-horizon decision-making, with applications spanning real-world mobile manipulation, multi-stage robotic tasks, and game AI.
